# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 (at start of series) to around 17  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v2 c23 P11](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c12 P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c38 P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029), [v1 c38 P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036), [v2 c6 P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Lucinda  <sub>[v1 c3 P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019), [v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021)</sub>; Seraphine  <sub>[v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is slender with sharp angles and a small pointed chin. She has striking grey eyes and pale skin that easily freckles, especially when exposed to the outdoors. Her most defining physical feature is her fiery, wind-ruffled bright red hair, which she usually wears in long plaits and has often felt self-conscious about.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c11 P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v1 c27 P18](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0018), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Nell is an imaginative, highly passionate, and vivid individual who routinely weaves elaborate fantasies into her daily life. She possesses intense emotions, holding deep affection for her close companions while also harboring stubborn, long-lasting grudges when insulted. Though prone to impulsive decisions, hot-tempered outbursts, and dramatic flare-ups, she maintains a strong sense of personal accountability and readily admits her mistakes once she realizes her fault.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021), [v1 c5 P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 c10 P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011), [v1 c15 P36](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0036), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v2 c2 P33](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0033), [v2 c12 P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036)_

## History

Born in Nova Scotia to a high school teacher and his wife, Nell Harcourt spent part of her early childhood in an asylum before being brought to Grey Shutters. Though the household initially expected a boy, Thirza and Obed kept her, and she quickly formed deep emotional ties to her new home. At Brierley school, she entered a bitter academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow after he teased her about her red hair, leading her to smash her slate over his head and refuse to speak to him for years. Over time, Nell grew close to her soulmate friend Isolde Pembroke and threw herself vigorously into school performances, local society projects, and high academic honors. During her time at Port Marlow Academy, she achieved top academic standings and won the Avery scholarship. Choosing to forgo university to stay at Grey Shutters and care for Thirza, Nell took up the teaching position at Brierley school. As a teacher, she gained the admiration of her young pupils, served as secretary for the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and helped orchestrate the rekindled romance and marriage of Miss Rosalind and Stephen Stanhope.
